QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `include/mbedtls/platform.h:163-167` makes them plain macros: `mbedtls_calloc` → `calloc`, `mbedtls_free` → `free`. There is no indirection.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that without MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY (the default) the two names are plain macros expanding directly to calloc/free, with no indirection.
